rows.grounds: fused sandhi clause aṣṭau me mūrtayaḥ santi

items.question: Which eight divine forms are self-manifested on earth?
items.inference: The verse states that eight forms are self-manifested on earth.
uncertainties: The fused sandhi forms are kept as single rows.
The exact referent of 'my' is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Eight of my forms are self-manifested on earth.
